overview: Shri Hoshnagi F&B Opp. is a mobile-first restaurant inventory and operations management PWA for daily stock balancing, order entry, and multi-restaurant management, running on the Internet Computer blockchain.
features: Daily closing balance and next-day order entry
Raised Concern workflow with permanent blockchain-persisted confirmation
Multi-restaurant support with per-user access control
Admin panel with reports, category/item assignment, and user management
Installable as PWA on Android and iOS
